content.title: On Grace and Free Will, chapter 17
content.author: Augustine of Hippo · New Advent edition
content.note: Limited use: faith is God's gift and good works follow it. Augustine predates the Reformation. This citation does not equate his entire account of justification with what Baptist and Reformed confessions teach.
